name: io.github.amber-tools/confluence-markdown
title: amber-confluence
description: Edit self-hosted Confluence (Server, Data Center) as Markdown. Macros come back byte for byte.

environmentVariables.name: AMBER_CONFLUENCE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Confluence Server or Data Center, e.g. https://wiki.example.com. Optional if set in ~/.config/amber/config.toml

environmentVariables.name: AMBER_CONFLUENCE_USER
environmentVariables.description: Your Confluence username. Leave out when using a personal access token

environmentVariables.name: AMBER_CONFLUENCE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal access token (Data Center 7.9+). Prefer the OS keychain; see the README
